summary: Part 1B was authorized. All pre-training verification gates that could be evaluated PASSED, but training was NOT started because the R2 frozen protocol contains no executable clean-v3 experiment_id, which is an unconditional STOP condition under Part 1B section 5. No optimizer was created, no model was constructed, no epoch was run, no checkpoint was written.

section_1_source_of_truth.detail: R2 JSON loaded; SHA and status both match the authorized values.

section_3_population_gates.method: inner join of manifests/phase4_v3/{train,val}.csv (dataset == KUB) with reports/tables/kub_view_type_inventory.csv on sample_id; FOV from the directory-semantics rule
section_3_population_gates.check_method_trap: Filtering reports/tables/kub_view_type_inventory.csv by its own 'split' column yields 771/106 because that column carries STALE phase4_v2 split labels. The active manifest MUST be joined in. Recorded so future parts do not mis-report the clean-v3 population.

section_5_experiment_id.requirement: Use the EXACT clean-v3 experiment ID specified by the R2 frozen protocol. Do NOT invent a new ID. Do NOT append _retry / _fix / _new / _v2 / _v3b. If the R2 artifact does not contain an executable experiment ID: STOP CHECK_REQUIRED before training.
section_5_experiment_id.finding: The R2 frozen protocol contains NO experiment_id field.
section_5_experiment_id.only_experiment_like_key_in_r2: experiment_a_modified (a governance flag, not an ID)
section_5_experiment_id.collision_risk: The historical runner derives the ID from --exp_id or defaults to phase13b_kub_localizer_r{resolution}_h{heatmap_resolution}_s{sigma}_seed42_v1, which is EXACTLY the frozen historical experiment directory. Using it would write into an immutable historical experiment (forbidden by sections 2 and 32). Deriving or inventing an ID is therefore unsafe as well as unauthorized.

section_6_run_lock.detail: Gate 5 stopped before run-lock acquisition. No lock was taken.

section_7_cuda_contract.detail: No device was requested and no CUDA check was performed because no training was started.

section_8_training_core.detail: R2 does not enumerate the scientific training core; section 8 explicitly permits reading it from 'the R2 frozen protocol / accepted historical reconstruction'. The core is recoverable from the Part-1A candidate protocol table plus the accepted historical reconstruction, so this is NOT itself a blocker.
fields_recoverable_from_part1a_candidate: loss (0.75 CenterNet focal + 0.25 soft Dice; alpha 0.25, gamma 2.0)

observed_order: 3. proposal configuration chosen from the grid (the VAL-dependent behaviour R1/R2 removed)
4. checkpoint score computed from that configuration
section_17_scheduler_early_stop_order.note: The historical localizer ordering is: scheduler stepped per epoch AFTER train+VAL and AFTER the selection bookkeeping, then history append, then latest.pt, then best.pt. Phase-10 segmentation ordering was NOT borrowed. This must be re-confirmed against the clean-v3 runner once that runner exists.

blockers.issue: The R2 frozen protocol contains no executable clean-v3 experiment_id.
blockers.required_from_supervisor: The exact clean-v3 experiment ID to use, or an authorized rule for deriving it from the historical ID.
blockers.why_not_resolved_locally: Section 5 forbids inventing an ID and forbids appending _retry/_fix/_new/_v2/_v3b; the historical default ID would collide with the immutable historical experiment directory.

blockers.issue: No executable clean-v3 localizer configuration exists. The artifact registry required by section 29 lists an 'executable config' that has no counterpart on disk. The only localizer config, configs/kub/phase13b_localizer.yaml, is the HISTORICAL v2 config (declares phase 13B; the historical runner hardcodes manifest_version 'phase4_v2').
blockers.required_from_supervisor: Authorization to create the clean-v3 executable config (and the clean-v3-safe training/validation wrapper), or a supervisor-supplied config path and SHA.

artifacts_not_created_and_why.phase13_clean_v3_localizer_training_star: Section 19 requires this 'before epoch 1'. Epoch 1 was never reached; no start audit is valid.
artifacts_not_created_and_why.phase13_clean_v3_localizer_training_comp: Section 21 requires this after natural completion. No training occurred.
artifacts_not_created_and_why.phase13_clean_v3_localizer_epoch_results: Section 22 derives this from an immutable history.csv. No history exists.
artifacts_not_created_and_why.phase13_clean_v3_localizer_training_revi: Section 24 requires a reviewer notebook over a completed run. Creating one would falsely imply training occurred.
